Overview.Name: Gangavaram Vadla Indumati
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Late_Morning (First Meal): Option 1: Paneer cubes (100 g) pan fried + any 1 fruit
Meal_2 (Afternoon Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd (200 g)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Meal_3 (Dinner - Main Focus): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & chicken curry (100 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (80 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs) + cucumber salad

Notes_and_Tips: For PCOS, start meals with protein before eating rice.
Keep dinner as your main structured meal but avoid overeating.
For sweet cravings, eat your regular meal first and wait 10 minutes.
Improve sleep duration as it directly affects hormones and cravings.
Consistency in routine will help improve fat loss and energy levels.
